summary: Server crash: using the Map item indexes skill -1
author: pm
body:
Using the Map item (item 104) crashes the game server with an access violation; the client then drops to the main menu. Reported by the user on 2026-11-24 while playing `Tz4423` on the local Debug server.

| fact | value | kind |
|---|---|---|
| crash | Server.exe 0xc0000005 at offset 0x44fafb, 2026-11-24 08:06:39 (Windows Application log) | measured |
| symbolized | `ItemManager::use_item_handler`, `sources/server/item_manager.cpp:2435` (as of 2026-11-24): `m_skill_config_list[m_related_skill]->m_value_2` | measured (llvm-symbolizer against the matching Server.pdb) |
| Map row in `items.data.sql` | item_type 5 (tool), sub_type 12 (map), effect 10 (ShowLocation), durability 35, related_skill -1 | measured |
| tools with durability 0 | none, so the ShowLocation branch (`it == tool && m_durability == 0`) is unreachable | measured |
| original (`HGServer/Game.cpp`, `Item.cfg` line 132) | Map is type 9 `DEF_ITEMTYPE_USE_PERM` with its own branch, separate from the skill-tool branch | measured |

So the Map falls into the skill-tool branch, which indexes `m_skill_using_status[-1]` and `m_skill_config_list[-1]`.

**Done when:** the ShowLocation branch is selected by `item_sub_type::map`; the skill-tool branch refuses a related skill that is out of range or has no config; using the Map on a mapped area opens the map dialog and on other maps shows "There isn't any map for this area.."; the server stays up; reviewed.

Source: user report 2026-11-24; WER report 67dd246b-3922-475f-84f3-ea4c75e5bfb6.
